 def runTo (M : TMN) (br : Branch) (Q : List Bool) (e : SConf) : Bool :=

+/-- Share the neutral prefix up to the physical register's decrement oracle. -/
+private def runDecnz (M : TMN) (r : Nat) (Q : List Bool) (e0 ep : SConf) : Bool :=
+  match KHomeReady.exec M none (fun
+      | (0, false, _, [.box (.mark r')]) => r == r'
+      | _ => false) FUEL (start Q) false with
+  | none => false
+  | some c =>
+      (KHomeReady.exec M (some (r, true)) (fun s => sMatches s e0) FUEL c true).isSome &&
+      (KHomeReady.exec M (some (r, false)) (fun s => sMatches s ep) FUEL c true).isSome
+
 def isHalt (s : SConf) : Bool := s.1 == 230
 
 def runHalt (M : TMN) (Q : List Bool) : Bool := (KHomeReady.exec M none isHalt FUEL (start Q) false).isSome

+
+private theorem runDecnz_sound {r : Nat} {Q : List Bool} {e0 ep : SConf}
+    (h : runDecnz M r Q e0 ep = true) (z : Bool) (n : Nat) {vs : List Nat}
+    (hv : Valid (some (r, z)) vs) :
+    Reach1 M (conc n vs (start Q)) (conc n vs (if z then e0 else ep)) := by
+  unfold runDecnz at h
+  split at h
+  · simp at h
+  · rename_i c hp
+    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
+    have hs : (KHomeReady.exec M (some (r, z))
+        (fun s => sMatches s (if z then e0 else ep)) FUEL c true).isSome = true := by
+      cases z
+      · exact h.2
+      · exact h.1
+    cases ht : KHomeReady.exec M (some (r, z))
+        (fun s => sMatches s (if z then e0 else ep)) FUEL c true with
+    | none => simp [ht] at hs
+    | some t =>
+        obtain ⟨hm, htail, _⟩ := KHomeReady.exec_sound B n hv FUEL c true t ht
+        obtain ⟨_, _, hprefix⟩ := KHomeReady.exec_sound B n (br := none)
+          ⟨hv.1, trivial⟩ FUEL (start Q) false c hp
+        rw [← sMatches_conc n vs hm]
+        exact (hprefix rfl).trans_reach htail
